'''''Fourth Wing''''' is a [[new adult fiction|new adult]] [[romantic fantasy|fantasy romance]] novel written by the American author [[Rebecca Yarros]]. It is the first book in the [[Rebecca Yarros#Empyrean series|''Empyrean'' series]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Empyrean |url=https://rebeccayarros.com/empyrean |access-date=2025-04-07 |website=Rebecca Yarros {{!}} #1 New York Times Bestselling Author |language=en-US}}</ref> following the journey of Violet Sorrengail, who is forced by her mother, General Sorrengail, to join the Basgiath War College and become a dragon rider in the kingdom of Navarre. Even though she has been trained her entire life to enter the [[Scribe]] Quadrant, Violet must endure deadly quests and competitions that push her to her limits while trying to avoid being killed by one of the most powerful riders in the quadrant, Xaden Riorson.

The book was published in the United States on May 2, 2023, by [[Red Tower Books]], an imprint of [[Entangled Publishing]]. Its viral success within [[TikTok]]'s reader community, [[BookTok]], significantly contributed to its No. 1 ranking on [[The New York Times Best Seller list|The New York Times bestseller list]]. It won The International Book of the Year 2024 at the annual [[TikTok Book Awards]]. The book sold over two million copies in its first six months and has been translated into approximately 30 languages.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Alter |first=Alexandra |date=2023-11-06 |title=How Rebecca Yarros Packed Dragons, Magic and Steamy Sex Into a Blockbuster Fantasy |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2023/11/06/books/rebecca-yarros-fourth-wing-iron-flame.html |access-date=2025-04-07 |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |issn=0362-4331}}</ref>

Yarros has mentioned in interviews that the idea for ''Fourth Wing'' emerged when her publisher announced that they were going to start a romantic fantasy line, prompting her to submit five proposals. After several reviews, her publisher selected the third idea, which explored the Empyrean world.<ref name=":02">{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?si=wbQd9EszbLc31eXU&v=S_Lm56IVaNw&feature=youtu.be |title='Fourth Wing' Author Rebecca Yarros on 'Iron Flame' and The Empyrean Series {{!}} Book Club |date=2023-11-22 |last=Entertainment Weekly |access-date=2025-04-07 |via=YouTube}}</ref> The inspiration for the story stems from her fascination with dragons, her husband's military experience, and her personal struggles.<ref name=":02" /> Violet's physical fragility, as described in the book, was influenced by Yarros's own experience living with [[Ehlers–Danlos syndrome|Ehlers-Danlos syndrome]], a genetic disorder affecting both her and her children. Yarros has expressed a desire to represent people with chronic illnesses, showcasing that they can also be heroic.<ref>{{Cite web |title=What Condition Does Violet Have in Fourth Wing? Rebecca Yarros Reveals Answer |url=https://www.health.com/rebecca-yarros-fourth-wing-interview-7569752#:~:text=Yarros:%20Violet%20having%20EDS%20is,Abnormal%20bruising%20and%20scarring |access-date=2025-04-07 |website=Health |language=en |archive-date=November 11, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231111172221/https://www.health.com/rebecca-yarros-fourth-wing-interview-7569752#:~:text=Yarros:%20Violet%20having%20EDS%20is,Abnormal%20bruising%20and%20scarring |url-status=dead }}</ref>
